# CDSKI - Clases de Ski y Snowboard en Chile

## About
CDSKI is a ski and snowboard school in Santiago, Chile. We offer group and private lessons at Valle Nevado, El Colorado, and La Parva ski resorts.

## Services
- Group ski lessons (max 6 people per group)
- Private ski lessons (1-on-1 instruction)
- Private snowboard lessons
- Heliski experiences
- Guided snow experiences
- Corporate and school group events

## Pricing (2026 Season)
- Half Day (3 hrs): From CLP $121,500 per person (group of 2+)
- Full Day (5 hrs): From CLP $154,200 per person (group)
- Private lesson (1 person): Half Day CLP $241,500 / Full Day CLP $275,000
- Equipment rental: CLP $65,000 per person

## Ski Resorts
- Valle Nevado (2,860m altitude)
- El Colorado
- La Parva (2,750m altitude)
- Farellones

## Contact
- WhatsApp: +56 9 4021 1459

- Languages: Spanish, English, Portuguese

## Location
Santiago, Chile (ski resorts are ~60km from downtown Santiago)
